encounter.title: Act I Encounter 8 — Square Candidate A (9x9 seed 12)
encounter.notes: LD-004 candidate A for Act I #8 (Pre-Boss Crucible). 9x9 seed 12 (20 arrows: N5 E5 S6 W4). Pattern: LAYERED GATES (5 concentric layers, 95% branch points). Chieftain and Caster are mandatory targets; Thrower W provides continuous artillery disruption. Intended sequence: #0(N) -> #4(E) interrupts lethal CAST IN 3 on turn 2 -> #3(E) -> #6(N) -> #7(N) eliminates Chieftain on turn 5 right before attack -> #2(E) eliminates Caster on turn 6. Immediate victory upon primary targets killed, 6 taps clean, 0 damage.
